name: Globidentosuchus
sum: Small, short-snouted basal caiman from the Miocene of Venezuela, with spherical teeth for cracking mollusc shells.
holotype: AMU-CURS-222 — a nearly complete skull with mandibles, Urumaco Formation, Venezuela.
material: Holotype, paratype AMU-CURS-224 and fragmentary skulls and jaws; a skull once called Melanosuchus fisheri was referred here in 2017.
biology: Its spherical crushing teeth broke the shells of molluscs (durophagy).
author: Scheyer et al. 2013
